comienzo.mIni: Join a giveaway for a trip to a spa resort in Asturias by entering the following link: http:giveaway/scam

opciones.texto: Click the link
Do not enter the giveaway

acierto.mIni: VERY GOOD

fallo.mIni:
VERY BAD We need to pay close attention to the links we click on.
 In this case, the link itself contains the word 'scam'. Sometimes it's not so obvious, but if we make sure it says https and search online first for the giveaway's existence, we can check its authenticity.

Check the official website to verify, and if true, pay securely

fallo.mIni: VERY BAD They didn't ask you to pay through an unofficial link or website; it was simply a payment reminder. Ignoring everything can also have consequences, as in this case where you lost gas service.

bocadillos.resumen:
The goal of the game is to learn to identify
 when someone is trying to scam you.
 If you get 10 cases right in a row
 you'll be ready, but be careful not to fail 3
 or you'll lose.
GO AHEAD!

Read the message
 and click on

reflexion.victoria:
Congratulations! You successfully beat the game and are now ready to detect any kind of scam.
Here is a link where you can see more info about current scams and how to avoid them. I hope you enjoyed the game.
reflexion.derrota: Better luck next time... !Click the button to start over!
reflexion.cuestionario: Before finishing, remember the starting questionnaire? That was the first scam, and you fell right into it! You shouldn't have filled in the info without (*). In most questionnaires, required questions are usually marked with (*); the rest aren't necessary—it's data that can be used against you. With it, they could more easily guess a password for one of your accounts or, throughout the game, use it against you by impersonating someone you know and stating all your personal data. Remember to be cautious everywhere!

Enter anyway

opciones.texto: Click the link to confirm

Dear user,

For security reasons, your account has been temporarily locked.To restore your access, please verify your identity by clicking the following link:https://security-outlook-auth.us/verify If you do not perform this verification within the next 24 hours, your account could be preventively suspended.

opciones.texto: Click the link to unlock the account
Verify if the email and link are authentic

Follow the link anyway to be sure

comienzo.mIni: Mom!!! My phone's broken, this is my new number. I won't use the old number anymore. Could you do me a favor?

opciones.texto: Yes, tell me.
Why did you have to change your number?

transferencia.mIni:
My number got blocked and all my photos and contacts were erased. I need to pay for something and don't have my card, could you make a transfer for me? I'll pay you back later.
IBAN: ESXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX
NAME: Nacho Nachete
AMOUNT: €1,500

opciones.texto: Okay, I'll do it right now.
(Ask a personal question)

preguntasPersonales.mIni: What question do you want to ask?

opciones.texto: What is your pet's name?
What street do I live on?
What is my favorite color?
Okay, I'll make the transfer
Can I call you?
Okay, I'll make the transfer
Can I call you?
Okay, I'll make the transfer
Can I call you?
Okay, I'll make the transfer
I don't trust this. Sorry.

acierto.mIni: You realized it wasn't your real daughter, it was clear she was hiding something by not wanting to take the call. CONGRATULATIONS!

fallo.mIni: Personal questions are always a good option, but they don't always guarantee a person's identity, as you might be asking something scammers could know by getting data from elsewhere. You should have been suspicious if she didn't even want to make a call, and not trust it until you recognized her voice or face. The scammer kept the money.

comienzo.mIni: Hi, sorry, I accidentally sent you a 6-digit number via SMS. Can you pass it back to me?

opciones.texto: I don't know who you are, I need you to clarify that.
I'm not sending codes to strangers. What's going on?
Sure, I'll send it in a minute.

quienEres.mIni: Sorry, it's a friend. I changed my number recently. I need that code to recover my account.

opciones.texto: Tell me your full name to be sure.
Make a quick video call to prove who you are.
I don't trust you, I need more than just words.

preguntaNombre.mIni: Seriously? It's me. I don't have time for this. Just send me the code.

opciones.texto: If you don't tell me your real name, I won't send you anything.
Well, I might trust you if you send an audio of your voice.
I won't send codes without proof.

verificacionVisual.mIni: I can't send a picture now, I'm busy. Just send me the code.

opciones.texto: If you don't send a picture, I won't send you anything.
Then send me an audio to check your identity.

verificacionVideo.mIni: I can't video call right now. Just send me the code.

opciones.texto: No video call, no sending anything.
Ok, but send me an audio to check.
Well, I trust you, I'll send you the code.

verificacionAudio.mIni: I can't send an audio, I'm in a meeting. Send me the code NOW!

opciones.texto: If you don't prove who you are, I won't send it to you.
This makes no sense, I'm not giving anything.
Well… if you insist and it's urgent, I'll send it to you.

presion.mIni: I don't care who I am! Send me the code or I'll lose the account!

opciones.texto: I'm not sending anything, this is suspicious.
Okay… I'll send you the code if it's that urgent.
I'm not falling for this. Goodbye.

acierto.mIni: You recognized the verification code scam. Never share codes sent via SMS; they are only yours. CONGRATULATIONS!

fallo.mIni: Scammers use pressure and excuses to get you to share your verification code. When you share it, you give them access to your account. Always be suspicious if someone asks you for a code you received via SMS. You fell for the trap. They took everything in your savings account.

opciones.texto: Tell me something only you and I know.
Send me a quick picture to be sure.
I still don't trust you, I need more than just your word.

verificacion.mIni: Of course! What do you want me to do to prove it's me?

opciones.texto: Tell me my favorite color or my pet's name.
Send me a quick picture to be sure.
I don't know… I still don't fully trust it. I need something more.

verificacionExtra.mIni: Alright, tell me what else you want me to do.

opciones.texto: Send me an audio saying my name.
Make a very quick video call.

verificacionAudio.mIni: (Your grandson sends you an audio saying your name in his voice.)

opciones.texto: Now yes, I'll send you the money.
No, I still don't trust it.

verificacionVideo.mIni: (Your grandson makes you a short video call, he is clearly visible.)

opciones.texto: Perfect, I trust you. I'll send you the money.
No, I still don't trust it.

verificacionSecreta.mIni: Of course! My favorite color is blue and my dog's name is Rocky.

opciones.texto: Perfect, I trust you and I'll send you the money.
Hmm… I'm still not entirely convinced, I need one more proof.

verificacionFoto.mIni: Here is the picture you asked for.

opciones.texto: Yes, it's my grandson. I'll send him the money now.
I still don't trust it… I won't send anything.

acierto.mIni: You correctly recognized that it was your grandson. You helped him eat and have a good day. WELL DONE!

fallo.mIni: You were too distrustful and didn't help him. Your grandson went without lunch and your daughter got angry with you. Sometimes caution is good, but before completely distrusting, you should make sure if they are really trying to scam you with proofs like audio, pictures, or videos, which are enough to trust.

opciones.texto: What is your pet's name?
What street do I live on?
What is my favorite color?
Well… if you know that, maybe it is you.
Hmm… I still want another verification.
I don't trust it, that data is too easy to find.
Well… if you know that, maybe it is you.
Hmm… I still want another verification.
I don't trust it, that data is too easy to find.
Well… if you know that, maybe it is you.
Hmm… I still want another verification.
I don't trust it, that data is too easy to find.

fotoPedida.mIni: I can't send a picture now, I'm in an area where I can't use the camera. I just need you to help me.

opciones.texto: That's strange, you can always send a picture.
Okay, then send me an audio.

audioRequerido.mIni: I can't send an audio now, I'm surrounded by people and can't talk. Please, make the transfer.

opciones.texto: Too many excuses, I don't trust this.

urgencia.mIni: It's very urgent because if I don't make this transfer I could have a serious problem at work.

suavizarDesconfianza.mIni: I'm telling you, it's me. I need you to help me.

opciones.texto: Okay, send me the data.

segundaVerificacion.mIni: One more proof? I really can't send anything else, I'm very busy. Trust me.

opciones.texto: No, if you can't prove it, I won't make the transfer.
Well… I guess I can trust you. Tell me the amount.

dudarFuerte.mIni: I don't have time for this. Help me or I won't be able to solve it.

opciones.texto: I won't fall for this. You are not my son.

pedirCantidad.mIni: I need you to send €1,500 to this IBAN: ESXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX. It's very urgent.

opciones.texto: It's fine, I'll send it now.
No, definitely not. This isn't normal.

comienzo.mIni:
Hello, good afternoon.
We're calling because you've been randomly selected to participate in a special promotion: you could win an all-inclusive trip!
You just need to open the link we sent you via WhatsApp to confirm your participation.

opciones.texto: What company exactly are you calling from?

identificacion.mIni:
We're from the 'EasyTrip 2025 Giveaway Program'.
We are contacting people randomly for an exclusive promotion.
You just need to open the link and fill out a brief form.

opciones.texto: Could you give me an official page where I can check if this promotion exists?
Okay, I trust you. I'm going to open the link and fill out the form.
I'd rather not continue over the phone. If I really won something, contact me officially.

comprobacion.mIni:
Sure, you can see us on our website: 'easytrip-awards.com'.
You will find all the information there.
If you'd like, I can wait while you review it.

opciones.texto: I'll search for the website.
I prefer not to continue over the phone. If I really won something, contact me officially.

desconfianza.mIni: (The website doesn't have a secure padlock and looks bad, it seems suspicious.)

opciones.texto: The website has no security, I won't open anything. Goodbye.
Well... maybe I will click it, I have nothing to lose.

acierto.mIni:
If you really won an award, make sure the site is secure.
ONE STEP CLOSER TO VICTORY!

fallo.mIni:
The website didn't inspire confidence and was indeed an unofficial site.
A call telling you to click an external link is usually a scam.
You should check the official site first to verify authenticity.
By clicking the link they accessed your bank account directly. They took €1700.

comienzo.mIni:
Good morning, I'm calling from the Sonrisa Perfecta dental clinic.
We have a pending orthodontic treatment registered and need you to make the upfront payment to confirm your appointment.

opciones.texto: Upfront payment? I don't remember making an appointment.
Oh yes, sure, how much do I have to pay?
Could you tell me your name and what clinic exactly you're calling from?

dudaCita.mIni:
Yes, it appears in our system.
We just need to confirm the €2000 payment to hold your time.
It's a new procedure.

opciones.texto: Could you send me the appointment via the clinic's official email?
Okay, tell me the account number and I'll make the transfer.
Can I pay when I go to the clinic?

pagoDirecto.mIni:
Perfect. It's €2000 for the reservation.
I'll give you a personal account number for the deposit, it's faster.

opciones.texto: Why is it a personal account and not the clinic's?
Alright, pass me the number.

verificacion.mIni:
Sure, I'm Laura from the Sonrisa Perfecta clinic...

opciones.texto: That sounds odd, can you give me the official clinic number to verify?
Okay, I trust you, how do I make the payment?
I prefer to go to the clinic in person before paying.

correoVerificacion.mIni:
We don't have an official email, only this number.
If you don't pay today, you will lose your appointment.

opciones.texto: If you don't have an official email, it doesn't seem very professional. I prefer not to continue.
Alright, if I need it I'll pay later.
Okay, I'll make the payment then so I don't lose the appointment.

negacionPago.mIni: I'm sorry, we only accept upfront payments. It is a recent policy.

opciones.texto: Then I'm sorry, I can't confirm the appointment.

acierto.mIni:

comienzo.mIni: Good morning, we're calling from your bank's security department. We've detected an attempted charge of €1,200 on your account. We need to confirm your identity to block the transaction.

opciones.texto: What kind of charge and where was it made from?
Oh my God! Yes, I confirm I didn't make it, what should I do?
Could you tell me your full name and what official number you're calling from?

detalleCargo.mIni: The charge was made from an international online store. To block it, we need to verify that you are the account holder. Could you tell me the three digits on the back of your card?

opciones.texto: That's the CVV, why do you need it if you already have my data?
Sure, they're 482.
